newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 13.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 14 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Having signed a peace agreement with Chechnya, Boris Yeltsin, as the president of democratic Russia, has scored a victory over Boris Yeltsin, a member of the Soviet Empire establishment.
- Russia's Defence Ministry officials have mismanaged eight billion roubles ( about $4,2 million) of the federal budget funds meant for the army food supplies.
- A communal and housing reform proposed by the government, has raised heated public debates.
- Some Western experts think that President Boris Yeltsin and Russia's Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov have absolutely different opinions about NATO's expansion problem.
- According to First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais, the 1998 federal budget would be drastically different from the previous ones.
